SAS to R maps common SAS programming tasks to R: the call, the result, and
places where the two languages diverge.

Home lists topics by group. Search matches SAS or R names.

The [cheat sheet](cheatsheet.qmd) is one page of short SAS-to-R code pairs.
For more detail, open a topic page.

This site is not affiliated with SAS Institute Inc.
